Signal refresh: Moment (top A, 83) and Pivot (B, 70) hold steady — Pivot adds a DoorDash European-entity expansion datapoint; Unframe ($100M TCV / 400% NRR confirmed, US/Cupertino but off-FS-center) and Bunch (150 managers / 12k LPs / 300% ARR, but Berlin — persistent geo tension) both steady. Legal-freelance windows flagged closing on 5/22 (MLA Interim Fund Formation, Latitude #6939 Investment Funds, Etsy/Mom Project Interim Securities Counsel) did not resurface — presumed filled/expired over the holiday weekend. Deduped against daily/pr-freelance/legal-freelance reports May 6–22.

KEY CAVEAT (drives the modest intent score): at ~$170M raised, ~312 employees, with a CEO who already does extensive earned media (McKinsey interview, Visa perspectives, multiple podcasts), Sardine is almost certainly served by in-house comms and/or an incumbent agency — NOT a greenfield first-PR-hire.
